# CI-only answers fixture for `orc init --answers` -- issue #171 made this
# repo's own orchestrator.yaml/souls/*.md untracked (per-project files,
# matching AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/GEMINI.md/review-protocol.md's existing
# convention). A dev machine still has the pre-migration file physically
# on disk (git rm --cached never deletes it); a genuinely fresh checkout
# -- CI's own `actions/checkout`, or any new contributor's first clone --
# does not. Several tests (repo-gitignore, orc-worktree-config-copy,
# orc-seed-merge-watch, watch) resolve the real project root via
# lib/harness-root.sh and need a physical orchestrator.yaml to exist,
# same as any real checkout of this dogfood room would have. CI runs
# `orc init --answers .github/ci-orchestrator-answers.txt .` before the
# test suite to provision exactly that -- values here MUST match this
# repo's actual identity (see decisions.log if these ever drift from the
# live room's own orchestrator.yaml).
